source.content:
Bane of Azeroth brings the kin, classes, magic, equipment, companions, and summoned creatures of Azeroth to Dragonbane. These options extend character creation without replacing the rules in the Dragonbane core set.

This journal collects the options used when creating and advancing a hero of Azeroth.

Creating a Hero of Azeroth

  1. Choose or roll your @Ref[boa:journal-page.player-options.kin]{Kin}.
  2. Record the movement for your kin under @Ref[boa:journal-page.player-options.derived-ratings]{Derived Ratings}.
  3. Choose one starting option from @Ref[boa:journal-page.player-options.heroic-class-abilities]{Heroic Class Abilities}, following the requirements on that page.
  4. Complete the remaining character creation steps using the Dragonbane core rules.
